description_excerpt: Role Purpose Winding cones, cops of dye-yarn as production requirement Principal Accountabilities and Key Activities Follow procedures, work instructions for operating winding machine Ensure productivity, quality of winding meet company requirements. Operate winding machines following defined instructions, monitor winding process to adjust tension and layer Check the quality of pre and post winding WIP so that only qualified WIP are transferred to the next step Keep machines, controlling box and surrounding areas clean and tidy Education, Qualifications and Experience Essential Desirable •…
